actions: I sit up and look around to get my bearings.
I get out of bed and head toward the front to see what's out there.
I head over to talk to Dalla and ask what day it is.
I ask Dalla what's got them worried.
I lean against the bar and wait, not pushing, just making it clear I'm listening if they want to talk.
I listen to her talk through it all, then ask if there's anything I can actually help with.
I nod and tell her I'll keep an eye out, then ask where I haven't explored yet in this place.
I finish my conversation with Dalla and head back into the inn itself, looking for any rooms or spaces I haven't seen yet.
I head up the narrow staircase to check out the upper floor.
I look around at the storage space to see what's actually being kept up here.
I take stock of what's actually stored up here on this upper floor — what's in the corners, against the walls.
I back off from whatever that was and look around more carefully at what else is up here in the storage space.
I head back downstairs to get my bearings on the layout of this place and figure out what other buildings are actually part of this inn versus separate structures.
I step back outside and look around to see the full layout of the settlement and what other buildings are nearby.
I walk over to the stranger watching from the edges and ask them what they're doing here.
I ask Elske what's troubling them, since they seem on edge about something.
I nod once and walk away, heading toward the building to the south that I haven't explored yet.
I turn back from the road and head directly toward the building that's supposed to be nearby, trying to actually enter it instead of just wandering the settlement.
I go back inside the inn and check the doorway deeper in that I saw from my bedroom — the one I haven't actually gone through yet.
I head back to my room and open that iron-bound chest I saw there this morning.
I look inside the chest to see what's in it.
I unfold the letter and read what's written inside.
I tuck the letter back into the chest and head through that deeper doorway I haven't explored yet.
I step back out to the common room and ask Dalla which doorway leads deeper into the inn.
I head back to my room and try that deeper doorway again, this time pushing through more deliberately.
